summary: Tested 6 new features for LUIGGI HOME Kitchen ERP. All features verified working: Portal de Fábrica with 3 tabs (Órdenes, Dashboard, Historial), Production Dashboard with metrics and charts (donut, bar, 7-day trend), History timeline with date-grouped events, SALAMANCA and ZAMORA in factory bar chart, BoardOptimizer with CSV Seccionadora and CSV CNC buttons, and Factory selector in user form when FÁBRICA permission is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionDashboard.jsx correctly implements donut chart for order status, bar chart for orders by factory (showing SAL, ZAM), and 7-day trend chart
OrderHistory.jsx properly groups events by date and shows timeline with expandable entries
PortalFabrica.jsx has all 3 tabs with data-testid: tab-orders, tab-dashboard, tab-history
BoardOptimizer.jsx has both CSV export buttons: export-csv-seccionadora (amber) and export-csv-cnc (blue)
SettingsModal.jsx shows FÁBRICA checkbox in CAPACIDADES TÉCNICAS, and factory dropdown appears with SALAMANCA/ZAMORA options when enabled

success_rate.backend: 100% - Factories API returns SALAMANCA (SAL) and ZAMORA (ZAM) correctly

seed_data_creation: None needed - factories SALAMANCA and ZAMORA auto-seeded on startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested features verified working in iteration 30. Portal de Fábrica accessible via FÁBRICA link in sidebar. Dashboard shows real-time metrics with SAL/ZAM factory chart. BoardOptimizer accessible via DESPIECE modal footer button 'OPTIMIZAR TABLEROS'. Factory selector in user form requires clicking FÁBRICA checkbox in CAPACIDADES TÉCNICAS section.

1_portal_fabrica_3_tabs.details: Portal de Fábrica shows 3 tabs: Órdenes (tab-orders), Dashboard (tab-dashboard), Historial (tab-history)

2_dashboard_produccion_graficas.details: Dashboard de Producción shows: metric cards (Órdenes Activas, En Producción, Listas, Entregadas, Retrasadas, Piezas Total), donut chart 'Órdenes por Estado', bar chart 'Órdenes por Fábrica', line chart 'Órdenes (Últimos 7 días)', progress bar 'Progreso de Fabricación Global'

3_historial_trazabilidad_timeline.details: Historial y Trazabilidad shows timeline with events grouped by date (e.g., 'Miércoles, 18 De Marzo De 2026 - 1 eventos'), expandable entries showing order details

4_salamanca_zamora_in_chart.details: Bar chart 'Órdenes por Fábrica' shows SAL (SALAMANCA), ZAM (ZAMORA), and 'Sin asignar' columns. API /api/fabrica/factories confirms both factories exist.

5_board_optimizer_csv_buttons.details: BoardOptimizer modal (OPTIMIZADOR DE TABLEROS) has: 'CSV Seccionadora' button (data-testid='export-csv-seccionadora', amber color), 'CSV CNC' button (data-testid='export-csv-cnc', blue color), 'PDF' button (red)

6_factory_selector_in_user_form.details: User form in PANEL MAESTRO > RED DISTRIBUCIÓN shows FÁBRICA checkbox in CAPACIDADES TÉCNICAS. When enabled, factory selector dropdown with SALAMANCA/ZAMORA options is available (verified via page content search).

api_tests.factories_list: GET /api/fabrica/factories - 200 OK, returns 3 factories (SAL, ZAM, TST)
